title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 3: the laws for peace offerings from the herd, the lamb and the goat, and the fat that is Yahweh's.

questions.text: What kind of animal from the herd could be offered as a peace offering?
questions.explanation: If he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before Yahweh.

answers.text: A male or a female, without defect
Any animal, even one with a defect

questions.text: Where was the peace offering from the herd to be killed?
questions.explanation: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: Outside the camp, in a clean place
At the door of the Tent of Meeting
Inside the holy place, before the veil
By the river, away from the tents

questions.text: Besides the fat, which parts of a peace offering were taken away to be burned?
questions.explanation: The two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

answers.text: The heart, the lungs and the head
The two kidneys and the cover on the liver
The skin and the horns of the animal

questions.text: On top of what did Aaron's sons burn the peace offering?
questions.explanation: Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire.

answers.text: On the golden altar of incense inside the tent
On the table of show bread in the tent
In a pit outside the camp
On the burnt offering, on the wood on the altar

questions.text: What did the man do just before killing a lamb as a peace offering?
questions.explanation: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: He laid his hand on its head
He tied it to the horns of the altar

questions.text: What was taken away close to the backbone of a peace offering from the flock?
questions.explanation: He shall take away its fat, the entire tail fat, close to the backbone.

questions.text: How is the part that the priest burns described in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.

answers.text: Bread for the priests to eat
A gift to be shared with the poor
A memorial of the first fruits
The food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh

questions.text: Besides animals from the herd and lambs, which animal is mentioned as a peace offering?
questions.explanation: If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh.

questions.text: According to the end of this law, whose is all the fat?
questions.explanation: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh's.

questions.text: What did the perpetual statute at the end of the chapter forbid the people to eat?
questions.explanation: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.
